486:t_039:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「One day you will learn, Wingless...! You will learn the terror of what lies beyond the light and darkness you believe in!」

486:t_040:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「His parting threats are so damn poetic, I can't make sense of them.」

486:t_040:2.en:
$$メール$$
「Don't worry about things you can't figure out, no matter how much you think!」

486:t_040:4.en:
$$不動$$
「Do not worry any longer, $$ミコノ・スズシロ$$. You have done what you needed to do.」

486:t_040:6.en:
$$不動$$
「I have nothing more to teach them. Now see with your own eyes and move forward on your own feet.」

486:t_041:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Coward...! You abandoned the True War in the name of your duty as a higher-dimensional life-form!」

486:t_041:2.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Here I come, $c! If you have accepted darkness, then rot away within this place!」

486:t_041:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「...We, too, will die someday... But that time is not now!」

486:t_041:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「We have things we must do! We won't stop until we restore peace to Earth and the universe!!」

486:t_042:3.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「You don't need to worry about that.」

486:t_042:4.en:
$$グーラ$$
「You have awakened to the sun's radiance, and $$ズール$$ and Father have withdrawn. This world's balance is returning to normal.」

486:t_042:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
「This is the world of darkness... The living cannot remain here.」

486:t_042:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I see. We're outsiders here, so we'll return to our own world.」

486:t_043:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's all right, $$ロゼ$$. I may never see my brother again, but he is always within me.」

486:t_043:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「So I'm not lonely. I'll return to our world with my vow renewed.」

486:t_043:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「That's right. We still have much to do.」

486:t_043:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go back. So we can fight.」

486:t_043:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「Yes... Let's keep fighting until the day we restore peace.」

486:t_044:0.en:
$$タケル$$
(Let's go, Brother. Our fight is only beginning.)

486:t_045:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Tch! No wonder they bear the $$烙印$$!」

486:t_045:1.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「We shall need suitable preparations to face them!」

486:t_046:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「No... $$ゲシュタルト$$ is merely $$ズール$$'s avatar.」

486:t_046:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So we have to beat the real one.」

486:t_046:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then we'll just have to beat that Emperor $$ズール$$.」

486:t_046:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Then we'll just have to beat that Emperor $$ズール$$.」

486:t_046:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Then we'll just have to beat that Emperor $$ズール$$.」

486:t_046:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Though we don't know where he went...」

486:t_046:7.en:
$$タケル$$
(What preparations did they mean...? Just what is waiting there...?)

486:t_047:0.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Hehe! We make a great team!」

486:t_047:1.en:
$$ダリー$$
「We're twins who've always been together.」

486:t_047:2.en:
$$ギミー$$
「And we aren't quarreling twins! I'm counting on you from here on, too, $$ダリー$$!」

486:t_047:3.en:
$$ダリー$$
「And I'm counting on you, $$ギミー$$.」

486:t_100:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I got in the EVA to fight the Angels...)

486:t_100:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
(It was painful back then, but it was much better than now...)

486:t_100:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
(...But I can't go back to those days anymore...)

486:t_101:0.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Hah! An Angel I've only seen in the data!」

486:t_101:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
「But even Brat $$シンジ$$ beat it! There's no way the current me will lose!」

486:t_102:0.en:
$$アスカ$$
(The first Angel I fought... The one from when I first met Brat $$シンジ$$...)

486:t_102:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
(I can't go back to those days...! I'm not the same person I was then, either!)

486:t_103:0.en:
$$タケル$$
(I can feel my brother within me...)

486:t_103:1.en:
$$タケル$$
(I'll do it, Brother...! Whatever future awaits, I'll fight for the vow we made!)

486:t_104:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$グーラ$$! From today on, you're one of us!」

486:t_104:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「You would call someone like me your ally...?」

486:t_104:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm glad. If my friend was troubled, I'd be troubled, too.」

486:t_104:6.en:
$$グーラ$$
「That has a nice ring to it.」

486:t_104:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do this, $$グーラ$$! I'm counting on you to lend us your strength!」

486:t_104:8.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I know! I'll do what I can for this universe, too!」

486:t_105:0.en:
$$万丈$$
(Father... I still have no intention of forgiving you...)

486:t_105:1.en:
$$万丈$$
(But somewhere in my heart, perhaps I believe that you, too, had faith in humanity's future...)

486:t_105:2.en:
$$万丈$$
(I will move toward the future in a different way from you. Alongside this $$ダイターン３$$...!)

486:t_106:0.en:
$n
(Beyond light and darkness... That's what humanity is...)

486:t_106:1.en:
$n
(What lies beyond conflicting emotions is the true essence of the $$いがみ合う双子$$...)

486:t_107:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
(He appeared as if he knew we were in trouble, but...)

491:t_1:3.en: ～ $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ Command Room ～

491:t_1:4.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...So the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and the $$クォーター$$ have discovered $$アマルガム$$'s ultimate goal?」

491:t_1:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We don't know the details, either. Captain $$テスタロッサ$$'s message only told us of an emergency and where to rendezvous.」

491:t_1:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We will have to hear the details after we join them.」

491:t_1:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「As for the fighting in space, we secured the cooperation of $$ハマーン・カーン$$'s group, which defected from $$ネオ・ジオン$$, and $$ギュネイ・ガス$$.」
